reports.title: On Reports Results for the Third Quarter and Nine-Month Period Ended September 30, 2026

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: With its holiday campaign now live and its newest technologies and products landing with consumers, On plans for net sales growth to accelerate in the fourth quarter. On will run the holiday season the way it has run the whole year, remaining committed to its premium positioning and full price discipline in a promotional environment.

On’s outlook now includes U.S. tariff refunds, so margin guidance is shown both including and excluding them; previous guidance did not include U.S. tariff refunds. For full-year 2026, On now expects:
•Net sales: Expected to grow in the low-20% range on a constant currency basis (unchanged). At current spot rates, this implies absolute net sales of CHF 3.47 billion to CHF 3.56 billion.
•Gross profit margin: Expected to be around 67.5%, or around 66% excluding U.S. tariff refunds (previously at least 65%).
•Adjusted EBITDA margin: Expected to be in the range of 21.0% to 21.5%, or in the range of 19.5% to 20.0% excluding U.S. tariff refunds (unchanged).

Other than with respect to IFRS net sales and gross profit margin, On only provides guidance on a non-IFRS basis. The Company does not provide a reconciliation of forward-looking adjusted EBITDA to IFRS net income due to the inherent difficulty in forecasting and quantifying certain amounts that are necessary for such reconciliation. As a result, we are not able to forecast with reasonable certainty all deductions needed in order to provide a reconciliation to net income. The above outlook is based on current market conditions and reflects the Company’s current and preliminary estimates of market and operating conditions and customer demand, which are all subject to change. The gross profit margin excluding U.S. tariff refunds excludes impacts from the CHF 52.6 million U.S. tariff refunds received during the three months ended September 30, 2026. Actual results and the timing of events could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of risks and uncertainties, including those stated below and in our filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC").
